Referenced by results, qualifying, lapTimes, pitStops, driverStandings and constructorResults."}, "columns": {"col_001": {"role": "identifier", "name": "driver_id", "description": "Primary key; unique numeric identifier for each driver, referenced by results, qualifying, lapTimes, pitStops, driverStandings, constructorResults.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_002": {"role": "identifier", "name": "driver_ref", "description": "Unique slug/code identifying the driver (lowercase surname-based, e.g. 'gilles_villeneuve'), used as a textual reference key.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_003": {"role": "code", "name": "driver_number", "description": "Permanent car/race number of the driver (2-99); null for ~96% of rows, mostly older drivers before permanent numbering.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_004": {"role": "code", "name": "driver_code", "description": "Three-letter driver abbreviation (e.g. VER, ROS, SAI) used in timing screens; null for ~90% of rows.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_005": {"role": "numeric", "name": "forename", "description": "Driver's first/given name.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_006": {"role": "numeric", "name": "surname", "description": "Driver's last/family name.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_007": {"role": "numeric", "name": "dob", "description": "Driver's date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD); range 1896-1998.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_008": {"role": "category", "name": "nationality", "description": "Driver's nationality as an adjective (British, American, Italian, ...).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_009": {"role": "numeric", "name": "url", "description": "Wikipedia URL for the driver's page; empty string for one row.", "status": "resolved"}}}
